privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_text: We collect full name, CPF, e-mail, phone, address and patient health information (diagnoses, medications, allergies) necessary for providing the service.
privacy.s2_text: Your data is used exclusively to: connect you to healthcare professionals, process appointments and payments, and improve the platform. We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.s3_text: We only share the necessary information with the professional you hire (patient name, relevant health conditions and service address).
privacy.s4_text: We use encryption and security best practices to protect your data. Passwords are never stored in plain text.
privacy.s5_text: In compliance with LGPD (Law 13.709/2018), you have the right to access, correct or request the deletion of your data at any time. Contact us: privacidade@cuida.me
privacy.s6_text: We use cookies only to keep your session active. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.s1_text: By using the Cuida.me platform, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use our services.
terms.s2_text: Cuida.me is a marketplace platform that connects families and patients to verified home healthcare professionals. We are not employers of the registered professionals.
terms.s3_text: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided during registration. Misuse of the platform may result in account cancellation.
terms.s4_text: All professionals undergo a document verification and approval process by our team before appearing to clients. We still recommend that users make their own evaluations.
terms.s5_text: Cuida.me charges a 12% commission on each service for platform maintenance. Payments are processed securely.
terms.s6_text: Cancellations must be made at least 2 hours in advance. Late cancellations may be subject to charges.
